name: id
description: The ID of the action link.

name: text
description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text to use within the action link. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

name: html
description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML to use within the action link. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

name: caller
description: Not strictly a parameter but [Nunjucks code convention](https://mozilla.github.io/nunjucks/templating.html#call). Using a `call` block enables you to call a macro with all the text inside the tag. This is helpful if you want to pass a lot of content into a macro. To use it, you will need to wrap the entire action link component in a `call` block.

name: type
description: Type of `button` – `"button"` or `"submit"`. Defaults to `"submit"`. This has no effect on `a` elements.

name: href
description: The value of the link `href` attribute.

name: openInNewWindow
description: If set to `true`, then the link will open in a new window. This has no effect on `button` elements.

name: variant
description: Optional variant of action link. You can use only `"reverse"` or empty values with this option.

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the action link component.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the action link component.
